product.ta-1520.summary: The TA 1520 brought floppy disks to the TA 1540 data capture and preparation range.
product.ta-1520.history: Triumph-Adler presented it in Hanover in 1979 as a companion to the TA 1540.
product.ta-1520.technical.configuration: Floppy disks provided a medium for file-based work. The trade press describes the system as floppy-oriented.
product.ta-1520.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1520.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
product.ta-1520.technical.source_1: Computerwoche · Triumph-Adler setzt weiterhin auf den Fachhändler (1979)
